Balaur deals 3 damage to each creature chosen this way. Whenever you sacrifice a creature you control as a cost to cast a spell, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)

card.name: Hrybok, Progenitor Supreme
card.text: Hrybok, Progenitor Supreme enters the battlefield with two spore counters on it for each {G} spent to cast it beyond the third. Remove two spore counters from creatures you control: Target creature gains menace and trample until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery. {1}, Remove a spore counter from Hrybok: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.

card.name: Ulama, the Exalted Wind
card.text: Flying Whirlwind (Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may exile it. Then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.) When Ulama, the Exalted Wind enters the battlefield, exile up to one target creature. Its controller scours a land card. (To scour a land card., that player reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card.. They put that card into their hand and the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.)

card.name: Taitai, Fearless Captain
card.text: Notoriety (If you control five or more artifacts and/or Pirates, you become notorious for the rest of the game.) When Taitai enters the battlefield, you may put a Vehicle card from your hand onto the battlefield. Whenever Taitai, Fearless Captain crews a vehicle, that Vehicle gains flying and prowess until end of turn. Then if you're notorious, untap Taitai.

card.name: Regina, Eternal Broodmother
card.text: Flying, lifelink Morbid—As long as a creature died this turn, you may cast Regina, Eternal Broodmother from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to its other costs. {2B}{2B}, Sacrifice another creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on Regina. Each opponent loses 2 life.

card.name: Gla'aki, Blood Poet
card.text: Gla'aki, Blood Poet attacks each combat if able. Whenever you sacrifice a creature, that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls. At the beginning of each end step, if Gla'aki, Blood Poet died this turn, return it from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

card.name: Hongo, the Ever-Expanding
card.text: Ward {2} Hongo, the Ever-Expanding isn't legendary if it's a token. At the beginning of each combat, put a spore counter on each Fungus you control. Remove four spore counters from Hongo: Create a token that's a copy of Hongo.
